_metadata.description: Tiered enhanced delivery systems for bioavailability scoring
_metadata.scoring_rule: Detection is not scoring eligibility. Ingredient chemistry/form quality and delivery may not count the same characteristic twice. Only a distinct, source-supported delivery mechanism not represented by the resolved form can earn separate credit; only the strongest eligible system counts.

tier_1.name: Premium Delivery
tier_1.description: Historical premium delivery magnitude, awarded only after independent mechanism and form-overlap checks.

tier_2.name: Enhanced Delivery
tier_2.description: Historical enhanced delivery magnitude, awarded only after independent mechanism and form-overlap checks.

tier_3.name: Basic Enhanced
tier_3.description: Historical basic delivery magnitude, awarded only after independent mechanism and form-overlap checks.

_metadata.detection_note: Label recognition retains all source matches. The shared scoring owner selects the strongest source-supported independent system after checking overlap with resolved form identity; a detected name or tier alone is not credit.
_metadata.pipeline_integration: Enrichment preserves detected terms; v4 scoring owns delivery eligibility and projects qualifying systems for export.
